# The Covernotes

> The Covernotes are a 4-piece live cover band based in Oakville, Ontario, Canada. They play weddings, corporate events, private parties, galas, festivals and community events across Toronto, Oakville, Burlington, Mississauga, Hamilton, Milton and the wider Greater Toronto Area (GTA), and travel anywhere in Ontario.

## Quick facts

- Line-up: 4-piece band (lead vocals, guitar, bass, drums) with multiple singers and multi-instrumentalists
- Repertoire: 100+ songs across pop, classic rock, Motown, soul, R&B, Latin, reggae and hip hop
- Standard package: 3 hours on site, two to three live sets, background music between sets at no extra charge
- Pricing: packages start from $900 CAD, depending on hours, travel and requirements
- Brings its own professional PA system; carries full public liability insurance
- Takes song requests, including first dances and special moments
- Book 6 to 12 months ahead for summer weekends, December and New Year's Eve; last-minute enquiries welcome
- Rated 5 stars by clients on Google and GigSalad

## Recent events

- CAMH Engage Gala (2026)
- Quinte West City Festival, Fusionfest (2026)
- Oakville Oak Park Neighbourhood Fair (2026)
- Sun Life corporate event, downtown Toronto
- Toronto Badminton and Racquet Club party (2025)
- Weddings, milestone birthdays (40th, 50th, 60th, 80th), anniversaries, street parties, rooftop corporate parties and fundraising galas
